g.text: what the bootloader does with every frame the SLIP RX state machine delivers
SLIP RX delivers a complete frame
Never answer a frame you cannot trust:
even SEQ may be the damaged byte.
The host times out and resends.
This is a resend because the response
an ERASE, WRITE or RUN must run once.
check payload length, address range and alignment,
then erase, or program and read back,
or compute CRC-32, or check the vector table
wait until the last byte has left the UART
jump to the application reset handler
